title: The Lantern of the Lower Danube
author: Rosalind Dravenmoor
blurb: Ansel Yarrow, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
